limitations: Untyped nativeSlot methods remain positional placeholders; do not call or override them before auditing. Typed pure slots175/199 have current machine-call evidence, but their original C++ names are unrecovered.
Host Family ABI, nonzero pipe-property, isochronous semantics, power management, recovery and the real platform resource provider are still required.

The Device adapter and request workers compile and link to the pinned Family; the native metaclass cannot allocate an instance and no Device personality is present. No kernel execution or USB enumeration has been verified.
Offline memory failures and worker interleavings use a fake memory API shared with DMA tests. Native IOMemoryAPI and IOKit worker lifetimes still need kernel runtime validation.

control_request_evidence.factory_parameters: IOUSBDeviceController *, int inEndpoint, int outEndpoint, UInt32 options
control_request_evidence.subclass_reservation: Aligned opaque 144-byte field reserves the entire 160-byte native object despite OSObject tail padding; a child UInt32 field produces size168.
control_request_evidence.process_setup_result: IOReturn; explicit 0 success and 0xe00002bc for invalid state. inputSetupPacket/inputDataPacket are void; do not infer a status from uninitialized x0 or a tail call.
control_request_evidence.workloop_requirement: Family tracker retains controller workloop and adds its own command gate; stop removes that event source before release.

endpoint_activation_evidence.argument_registers: x0 controller; w1 endpoint; w2 type; w3 maximum packet size; w4 interval; w5 pipe property
endpoint_activation_evidence.prototype: IOReturn activateEndpoint(int, int, int, int, tIOUSBDeviceInterfacePipeProperty)
endpoint_activation_evidence.enum_values: 0/1/2 accepted as opaque hints. They do not alter Native wire descriptors; standard descriptor-defined transactions are used without assigning burst/stream meanings.
endpoint_activation_evidence.correction: The previous four-int projection omitted the fifth argument; compiler probe now asserts the full member-pointer type.

create_buffer_evidence.observation: The first argument is forwarded into allocation option bits; the second becomes capacity and is limited to 1MiB. It is not a length/alignment pair.
